terbaru.judul: The Broad Impact of Feature Imitation: Neural Enhancements Across Financial, Speech, and Physiological Domains
terbaru.pelajaran: While the applicability of FINs has been chiefly tested in biomedical domains, this study extends its exploration into other time series datasets.

terbaru.judul: Bayesian framework for characterizing cryptocurrency market dynamics, structural dependency, and volatility using potential field
terbaru.pelajaran: In this paper, we present a unified Bayesian framework based on potential field theory and Gaussian Process to characterize the structural dependency of various cryptocurrencies, using historic price information.

terbaru.judul: Cryptocurrency Price Prediction using Twitter Sentiment Analysis
terbaru.pelajaran: In this study, we develop an end-to-end model that can forecast the sentiment of a set of tweets (using a Bidirectional Encoder Representations from Transformers - based Neural Network Model) and forecast the price of Bitcoin (using Gated Recurrent Unit) using the predicted sentiment and other metrics like historical cryptocurrency price

terbaru.judul: Improved Bitcoin Price Prediction based on COVID-19 data
terbaru.pelajaran: We find that adding COVID-19 data into the LSTM model improved prediction of Bitcoin prices.

terbaru.judul: Bi-LSTM Price Prediction based on Attention Mechanism
terbaru.pelajaran: In this paper, we propose a bidirectional LSTM neural network based on an attention mechanism, which is based on two popular assets, gold and bitcoin.

terbaru.judul: Evaluating Impact of Social Media Posts by Executives on Stock Prices
terbaru.pelajaran: This paper investigates the impact of social media posts on close price prediction of stocks using Twitter and Reddit posts.

terbaru.judul: Twitter Attribute Classification with Q-Learning on Bitcoin Price Prediction
terbaru.pelajaran: To address this issue, in this paper, we consider a classification of tweet attributes that effects on price changes and computer resource usage levels while obtaining an accurate price prediction.

terbaru.judul: Cross Cryptocurrency Relationship Mining for Bitcoin Price Prediction
terbaru.pelajaran: In this work, we propose a generic Cross-Cryptocurrency Relationship Mining module, named C2RM, which can effectively capture the synchronous and asynchronous impact factors between Bitcoin and related Altcoins.

terbaru.judul: Bitcoin Price Predictive Modeling Using Expert Correction
terbaru.pelajaran: The paper studies the linear model for Bitcoin price which includes regression features based on Bitcoin currency statistics, mining processes, Google search trends, Wikipedia pages visits.

terbaru.judul: Bitcoin Transaction Strategy Construction Based on Deep Reinforcement Learning
terbaru.pelajaran: This study proposes a framework for automatic high-frequency bitcoin transactions based on a deep reinforcement learning algorithm-proximal policy optimization (PPO).
